utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone in and around this courtroom. Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case IT-09-92-T, the Prosecutor versus Ratko Mladic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. I have a few preliminaries before we start hearing the testimony of the next witness. First - and I'm primarily addressing the Defence - the Defence had requested a standing authorisation for Mr. Ivetic and Mr. Petrusic, who have not been assigned as counsel for Mr. Mladic, to question witnesses and make submissions before the Chamber. The Chamber allows Mr. Ivetic and Mr. Petrusic to cross-examine witnesses and make witness-related submissions before the Chamber, provided that either counsel or co-counsel is present in the courtroom. It follows from that that non-witness-related submissions need to be made by counsel of record. Then another matter. The Chamber is seized of three Rule 92 bis motions covering a total of 21 witnesses. There are still around 220 witnesses for whom the Chamber can expect Rule 92 bis and quater motions. We are progressing with these proceedings at a steady rate and the Chamber wants to avoid a situation whereby it is halfway through the Prosecution's case and still needs to dispose of Rule 92 bis and quater motions covering over 200 witnesses. The Chamber is aware that its guidance on the filing of Rule 92 bis motions may affect the Prosecution's ability to complete all such filings within the next month. And the Chamber therefore requests an update from the Prosecution concerning its intended approach and if that could be given by the 24th of September, that would be appreciated.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Then for the next witness, we move into closed session and we'll remain in closed session for quite a while.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. We adjourn for the day and we'll resume tomorrow, Tuesday, the 18th of September, in this same courtroom, I, at 9.30 in the morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 18th day of September, 2012, at 9.30 a.m. 18 19 20 21 22 23 24 25
